notes.title: Major REDUX Update for Cast Of The Seven Godsends!
notes.content:
Exactly one year after Cast Of The Seven Godsends, we’re back with an updated version of the game, which we renamed "Redux". Over the past year we received a bunch of constructive criticism that has helped us improve the gameplay experience. We decided to give console owners the opportunity to play the game too and went about completely re-writing the game in Unity so we could further exploits the game’s potential - New physics, new shaders and greater adaptability to your hardware configuration. 

- New animations: we doubled the number of frames for the vast majority of the characters. The visuals are now far more fluid. 

- New engine: the action and movements are faster, the jumps are more controllable and have an expanded tolerance with which you can reach the platforms. The weapons trajectories are crisper; collisions are more accurate with a slight tendency in favor of the player. The camera distance allows for greater readability of the scene at any screen resolution. 

- New FXs: the flashes are brighter and more colorful, the fire is more alive than ever, the entire post-processing has been enhanced. One example, among many, is the fog at the beginning of the second level. Unity handles these effects depending on your configuration automatically, so it is no longer present deactivation option. But we added the effect scanlines / 80s tv, which accentuates the warm colors and gives a nostalgic effect that as many of you we also love passionately. 

- New save feature: many have asked us for save points and we just could not ignore it. Cast Of The Seven Godsends is and wants to be a tribute to the arcade of the old school, meant to be played with something that is as close as possible to an arcade cabinet. So we decided on a compromise: in the pause menu you will find the "Save level" choice that will store the level in which you are playing. From the main menu, selecting Load, you can start playing from that level. They are not saved nor checkpoints reached neither the obtained power ups and weapons. This is a feature that helps you train on the level without having to start from scratch each time, until you are indeed able to overcome it. This choice has also been made to preserve the longevity of the game. 

For now, it seems to have it all! Let us know what you think and tell us any bugs and possible improvements in the appropriate sections of the hub, we will always be ready to listen. We hope this new version will be to your liking. 

Unleash your rage from the deepest of your heart again! 

Kudos, 
R.T.S.

notes.title: How to beat the game - Tips 'n Tricks
notes.content:
Hi players! 

Seems you're having great fun with the game, so we'd like to reveal you some secrets about it.

If you're stuck, well, this should help you a little :)

---

[h1][b]ABOUT WEAPONS[/b][/h1]

BASIC FEATURES
[img]http://i.imgur.com/D0z9f4C.png[/img] [b]Knife[/b]: the fastest and weakest weapon, does little damage and requires accuracy on shooting. Goes straight, you can shot this weapon up to four times in a row.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/y4Lo67w.png[/img] [b]Mace[/b]: makes an upward curve. Average speed and damage. Works beautifully with flying monsters or every enemy which needs to be hitted on the head. Up to three shots in a row.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3bWEyiM.png[/img] [b]Spinning blade[/b]: makes a circle around you, then goes straight. Useful when you're surrounded. Up to four shots in a row.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HaG8PVL.png[/img] [b]Sword[/b]: very short range, average speed, low fire rating, but maximum damage, and, most importantly, destroys the enemy bullets. Do not underestimate the power of this weapon.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RBTAZ8u.png[/img] [b]Hammer[/b]: makes a downward curve. Good damage but average range and speed. Up to four shots in a row.

ADVANCED FEATURES are tied to the armor you're carrying on - we'll back on this later.


[h1][b]ABOUT ARMORS[/b][/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VF9dzgt.png[/img] [b]The Fire Armor[/b] protects you from natural fire. That means you can pass through the flame rows in level 1 or the flames in level 3 without getting damage - although the armor doesn't protect you from enemy fire bullets, of course. This armor is also very powerful against ice monsters, but it takes more time to kill the fire monsters. Some weapons are able to catch enemies on fire, making them burning, causing them further damage.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bFtK4M5.png[/img] [b]The Ice Armor[/b] works in the same manner, it stops you from sliding on the ice and works terribly well against fire monsters, but it will take more time to kill the ice monsters. Most important of all, this armor can freeze enemies for a short time if you're equipped with knife.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/32c9wva.png[/img] [b]The Plague Armor[/b] is slow but lethal like a plague. Lets you crawl quickly by pushing down-forward, that's useful to advance with less chances to be hitted frontally. This armor boasts some of the most powerful weapons of all, like the chasing bees or the demonic arm (which lets you run while shooting). This armor can also poison enemies, making them slow and unoffensive for a short time, and can make them bleeding, causing them further damage.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qZTRYeP.png[/img] [b]The Earth Armor[/b] is the most difficult one to use. It's the slowest but has the highest endurance. Its main feature is the vine: pushing up and jump at same time, you can throw a rope that grabs the nearest upper platform and lets you climb up. The rope can't hurt enemies and you can throw it only while you're lying on the ground. But it's incredibly useful in some sections, like in level 4, where you can use it to shortcut the path very quickly. This armors got also a parachute: if you press jump while falling, you will glide, that's useful for instance to attack enemies that are lying on the ground.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6gfFd2m.png[/img] [b]The Wind Armor[/b] is the fastest and less offensive armor, it's a good choice if you want to have a speedrun. You'll be able to fly (if you're carrying the mace) and you can use it to perform quick progress on your way. The armor also protects you from wind, so you won't be pushed back by the blizzard in level 3. If you got the spinning blade, try the hurricane spell, which will wipe out all the small foes and enemy bullets from the screen.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/F4WID02.png[/img] [b]The Lightning Armor[/b] was designed to be very aggressive and it's fast and powerful like electricity. This armor will improve your jump. The electric bats will produce a spark that will chase enemies when they will hit one of them. The lightning dragon is very very effective. Indeed one of the best armors overall.

 [img]http://i.imgur.com/QUOSeZK.png[/img] [b]The Black Armor[/b] : ???

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]ABOUT ENEMIES[/b][/h1]


[b]How to beat Red Taurus[/b]
Yes, he blocks everything (except some magic spells).
You basically have two ways to beat him:
- Hitting him while he's turning back
- Getting close to him and quickly moving backward when he raises the mace

Here's a video that shows you how to do it:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wUXRgSxFnjE


[b]The Troll[/b]
This enemy acts exactly like the Megaman's one with shield and phaser. You can hit him only while he's throwing the rock. You have to find the right time to attack him and avoid the rock - he will die with few hits.

[b]How to beat Mage[/b]
Level 1: if you get close to him, he will send you a lightning. So stay away and attack him from distance, or, if you got the sword, get close to him and prepare to run away quickly after your attack. After some hits, he will go in a sort of trance and will start to raise skeletons: this is the perfect moment to blast him. Watch out from skulls and lightnings he's throwing, and keep blasting him from the ground. Repeat the process until he dies. Remember: he cannot be poisoned.

[b]How to beat Fangster (Level 1 Boss)[/b]
You must hit him in the head. That will be easier if you're carrying the mace, otherwise you can jump and shoot by the floating platforms. When he's going to charge you, just run to the left edge on the screen to avoid his attack, or alternatively you can jump him from the floating platforms while he's running forward to you, but be sure to climb down the platforms quickly after you jumped, otherwise he could hurt you while he's getting back. Remember: ice weapons are particularly effective against him.

[b]How to beat Antirad (Level 2 Mid Boss)[/b] 
This recurring character is really annoying. You will meet him for the first time in level 2, on the top of the mill in the swamp. This first fight is clearly inspired by Megaman's boss fights. Keep in mind that he will try to jump to avoid your shots, so the best way to fight him is to constantly run away and shooting him using every fraction of time you can find, making sure that he will clash in your bullets meanwhile he's chasing you. It's a good idea to climb on the statue then jump forward while shooting down, for example. If you have the sword, remember that you can block his bullets, and this makes a great difference because you will have enough time to attack him closely then run away.
In level 4 and 6 things will be more complicated. He will be faster and more lethal, but remember that the key to win rest the same: run away and ambush him.

[b]How to beat Dragon Rider (Level 4 boss)[/b]
This is one of the hardest game bosses for sure. It will take a while to understand his patterns. Basically, he follows this schema:

- Throws 3 way fireballs
- Flies offscreen then charges
- Throws 3 way fireballs
- Spits big flame

And so on. When the fight begins, just stay on the left side and keep avoiding fireballs. When he's flying off to the left, run to the right side of the screen. The "back and charge" attack works like this: he takes note of your position, flies away, then he charges back to the position he took note before. So, when he's flying away, you have your time to move on and avoid his incoming attack. When he will miss you, you'll have precious seconds to BLAST him as much as you can. He then will start to spit fireballs again: jump on the cubes and go up away to avoid the fireballs, and keep avoiding him when he's spitting the big flame also. Meanwhile, keep shooting to him as much as you can. Repeat the process until he dies.


(TO BE CONTINUED)

notes.title: Technical FAQ - if you're having difficulties running the game, please read this.
notes.content:
[h1]CAST OF THE SEVEN GODSENDS v1.0.2 - Jul, 17, 2015[/h1]

The XNA Framework 4.0 Redistribuitable is installed by the game.
The game requires a graphics card that supports at least shader model 3.0,
otherwise you will recieve the error - "Error - No suitable graphics card supported"

[h1]WHAT TO DO IF THE GAME CRASHES[/h1]

Open Window Event Viewer by clicking the Windows Control Panel -> System and Security -> Administrative Tools -> Event Viewer.

Click Windows Registry -> Application on the treeview in the left side.

Search for the line marked as ".NET Runtime" with the red error icon.
Copy the "General" tab message, like [url=http://i.imgur.com/yl3Li23.png]this one here[/url].
Paste it here or send it to raventravelstudios@gmail.com

Sorry for any inconvenience.

[h1]CONTROLS[/h1]

[b]KEYBOARD[/b] - You can redefine the keys in the Options section of the game.
Basic input keys are:
[list][*]Arrow keys to [b]MOVE[/b]
[*]LeftAlt to [b]SHOOT[/b]
[*]Spacebar to [b]JUMP[/b][/list]
Please note - Some keyboards (such as laptop ones) could cause issues like stopping the  game responding to certain keys presses. In this case, try setting alternative keys in Options settings.

[b]GAMEPAD[/b]
The game works with an Xbox 360 compatible gamepad. If experiencing issues you don't you can use an emulator software like this one: http://www.jayceooi.com/download-xbox-360-controller-emulator-for-pc-games/

[b]ARCADE CABINET[/b]
Map your keys as you want for the Jamma ASD in the Redefine controls section of the Options panel.

[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]

If you have a NVidia graphics card, make sure to set "High Performance NVIDIA processor" for this game in the NVidia config panel, otherwise you could experience slowdowns or variable framerate issues.

Some HD Integrated Graphics chipsets may be not enough to run the game properly.

The game does use intense GPU power because of bloom fx and other strong shaders.

If your graphics hardware doesn’t work with the optimal settings, you may experience some slowdowns. In this case, go to the Options section of the game and try to set the Bloom FX to "Mild" or "None", and see if things gets improve.

You can also turn on Antialiasing to improve performance. If you run the game on a fast machine or you use a 144hz screen, the game could exceed the 60fps. In this case you can turn on the 60 FPS Locker to keep the game playable (you may need to configure vsync or gsync in the graphics card configuration panel).

[h1]RESOLUTION[/h1]

The game is tied to 720p resolution. We are currently working on 1080p version.
If you have a 1080p screen resolution, please consider to set it to 1280x720 so you can run the game in fullscreen avoiding the cropped view.

[h1]OPTIONS[/h1]

[b]FULLSCREEN[/b] - sets fullscreen on/off

[b]ANTIALIASING[/b] - sets antialiasing on/off

[b]BLOOM FX[/b] -this is for those who plays on older computers and are experiencing framerate issues. Setting to "Mild" or "None" will improve game speed but reduce background effects.d

[b]60FPS LOCKER[/b] - sets the fixed limit of 60fps. Use this if your pc runs the game too fast or you're playing on a 144hz screen.

[b]DIFFICULTY[/b] - sets the difficulty level of the game:
[list][*]Easy: 5 lives, 7 credits, no black armor, fake ending
[*]Normal: 5 lives, 5 credits, black armor, true ending

notes.title: Technical FAQ - if you're having difficulties running the game, please read this.
notes.content:
[h1]CAST OF THE SEVEN GODSENDS v1.0.2 - Jul, 17, 2015[/h1]

The XNA Framework 4.0 Redistribuitable is installed by the game.
The game requires a graphics card that supports at least shader model 3.0,
otherwise you will recieve the error - "Error - No suitable graphics card supported"

[h1]WHAT TO DO IF THE GAME CRASHES[/h1]

Open Window Event Viewer by clicking the Windows Control Panel -> System and Security -> Administrative Tools -> Event Viewer.

Click Windows Registry -> Application on the treeview in the left side.

Search for the line marked as ".NET Runtime" with the red error icon.
Copy the "General" tab message, like [url=http://i.imgur.com/yl3Li23.png]this one here[/url].
Paste it here or send it to raventravelstudios@gmail.com

Sorry for any inconvenience.

[h1]CONTROLS[/h1]

[b]KEYBOARD[/b] - You can redefine the keys in the Options section of the game.
Basic input keys are:
[list][*]Arrow keys to [b]MOVE[/b]
[*]LeftAlt to [b]SHOOT[/b]
[*]Spacebar to [b]JUMP[/b][/list]
Please note - Some keyboards (such as laptop ones) could cause issues like stopping the  game responding to certain keys presses. In this case, try setting alternative keys in Options settings.

[b]GAMEPAD[/b]
The game works with an Xbox 360 compatible gamepad. If experiencing issues you don't you can use an emulator software like this one: http://www.jayceooi.com/download-xbox-360-controller-emulator-for-pc-games/

[b]ARCADE CABINET[/b]
Map your keys as you want for the Jamma ASD in the Redefine controls section of the Options panel.

[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]

If you have a NVidia graphics card, make sure to set "High Performance NVIDIA processor" for this game in the NVidia config panel, otherwise you could experience slowdowns or variable framerate issues.

Some HD Integrated Graphics chipsets may be not enough to run the game properly.

The game does use intense GPU power because of bloom fx and other strong shaders.

If your graphics hardware doesn’t work with the optimal settings, you may experience some slowdowns. In this case, go to the Options section of the game and try to set the Bloom FX to "Mild" or "None", and see if things gets improve.

You can also turn on Antialiasing to improve performance. If you run the game on a fast machine or you use a 144hz screen, the game could exceed the 60fps. In this case you can turn on the 60 FPS Locker to keep the game playable (you may need to configure vsync or gsync in the graphics card configuration panel).

[h1]RESOLUTION[/h1]

The game is tied to 720p resolution. We are currently working on 1080p version.
If you have a 1080p screen resolution, please consider to set it to 1280x720 so you can run the game in fullscreen avoiding the cropped view.

[h1]OPTIONS[/h1]

[b]FULLSCREEN[/b] - sets fullscreen on/off

[b]ANTIALIASING[/b] - sets antialiasing on/off

[b]BLOOM FX[/b] -this is for those who plays on older computers and are experiencing framerate issues. Setting to "Mild" or "None" will improve game speed but reduce background effects.d

[b]60FPS LOCKER[/b] - sets the fixed limit of 60fps. Use this if your pc runs the game too fast or you're playing on a 144hz screen.

[b]DIFFICULTY[/b] - sets the difficulty level of the game:
[list][*]Easy: 5 lives, 7 credits, no black armor, fake ending
[*]Normal: 5 lives, 5 credits, black armor, true ending
[*]Hard: 5 lives, 4 credits, black armor, true ending, ending bonus screen 1
[*]Retrogamer: 5 lives, 3 credits, no lanterns, black armor, true ending, ending bonus screen 1, ending bonus screen 2[/list]
[b]LANGUAGE[/b] - sets the language of the game

[b]AUDIO[/b] - Sets the music and the sound fx and the volume level for each one
 
[b]REDEFINE CONTROLS[/b] - Sets keys or gamepad buttons to shoot and jump





[b]Enjoy the game.
Kudos,
RTS[/b]
